3.

Sri Swetashwa Agarwal, learned counsel appearing for the respondent no.1 submitted that against the order dated 11.06.2021, proceeding under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act,
1996 has been initiated.

He further submitted that in light of Section 3 (i) (b) of the National Highways (Manner of depositing the amount by the Central Government; making requisite funds available to the competent authority for acquisition of land) Rules, 2019, it is not required to pay the enhanced amount.

4. Be that as it may, the writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the Additional Sessions Judge, Court No. 1, Fatehpur to decide the Execution Case No. 1 of 2023 (Mahavir Singh Vs. Project Director and Another) in accordance with law, maximum within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy of this order after considering the objection so raised by respondent no.1.
